subject: Timeline compression: docs & enablement owners check
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Timeline compression request from Acme — quick owners check

Team —

Acme reached out this morning: they want to move our targeted activation from 2028-06-15 up to 2028-06-01. Theyre offering a small launch credit but need the reduced window for a customer marketing event. Id like to triage whether we can support a compressed timeline and what the minimal gating checklist looks like (docs, enablement, rollout safety).

Quick asks:
- Can each of you confirm owner-level blockers by EOD tomorrow? (docs, training, staging windows, rollback plan)
- If any item requires a formal exception (SLA or capacity), call it out explicitly and estimate mitigation time.
- Ill coordinate the ask back to Acme once we have a consolidated view.

Attachments: acme_compressed_timeline_proposal.pdf, gap_risk_matrix.xlsx

High-level thoughts: Im OK exploring a compressed path if we can lock a 2-week enablement sprint and a single controlled ramp. But we need explicit owners for docs and CS training; we cant have ownership ambiguity.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline compression request from Acme — quick owners check

Alex —

Short update from enablement side:
- Customer-facing docs: baseline runbook + quickstart exist; I can own a condensed Quick Guide (enablement_quickguide_v1.docx) by 2028-05-07 if we freeze scope today.
- CS training: need two 60-min sessions (one pre-launch, one day-of). I'll run them with Priya N. and a CS SME.
- Playbooks: rollback steps are currently distributed between Ops and Runtime teams; we need a single documented rollback owner.

Risks: compressing reduces time for scripting examples and internal dry-run. If we push to 06/01 we should shrink scope (no advanced telemetry integration at launch).

I'll attach a one-page checklist to this thread tomorrow.

—Marissa
Senior Enablement Manager
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline compression request from Acme — quick owners check

Marissa / Alex —

Operational items we need confirmed before approving a compressed window:
1) Staging window: need a dedicated 4-hour staging slot the week of 2028-05-20 for a full end-to-end smoke test (runtime + infra + networking). Ops will mark it as reserved if Marissa confirms test scope by 2028-05-08.
2) Capacity reservation: compressed ramp needs a soft capacity bump (Dedicated pool) for first 72 hours; finance approval required for temporary burst — expect 48-72h turnaround for sign-off.
3) Audit trail: must confirm audit/event retention settings for Acme's PII handling; security said this is non-negotiable for earlier launch.

I can be rollback owner but need a clear SLV (safety-level) to trigger rollback. If were okay with a staged 10% -> 50% -> 100% ramp with automated rollback on error-rate thresholds, Ops can implement it.

Quoted:
> "Ill coordinate the ask back to Acme once we have a consolidated view."

Sounds good. Ill coordinate on the staging slot once Marissa shares test scope.

—Kimberly
Head of Ops
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-06T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline compression request from Acme — quick owners check

Team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Two points from leadership:
- Tradeoffs: We can support 2028-06-01 under two options:
  Option A — Minimum safe scope: disable advanced telemetry + limit to single model variant; 2-week enablement; no marketplace listing at launch. (Lower revenue, higher safety)
  Option B — Moderate scope: keep telemetry but enforce 48h capacity ramp and dedicated burst; requires exception to standard staging lead time. (Higher revenue, requires procurement + Ops signoff)

- Decision ask: Id like us to choose by COB 2028-05-08 so Alex can get back to Acme. If we pick Option B, well need a fast procurement path and a one-time capacity commit.

Alex: please capture the clear owner map (docs / training / rollback) and the one-line tradeoff you plan to present to Acme. Ill back any exception requests to procurement/SRE if the owners sign off.

Vivek
VP, Product
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan (Acme Analytics) <jordan@acme-analytics.com>, Sara Patel (TerraCloud PM) <sara@terracloud.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final: decision & owner assignments for the compressed launch request (Acme)

Folks —

Thanks for aligning. Outcome and next steps below (short):

Decision: we will support a compressed launch targeting 2028-06-01 under Option B (Moderate scope) with the following constraints: limit to single model variant, 48h capacity ramp with dedicated burst, and no marketplace listing at initial launch. Procurement will treat the capacity bump as a one-time committed burst for the first 7 days.

Owner map (owners to act by 2028-05-12 unless noted):
- Docs (customer quick guide & runbook): Marissa Cole (deliver enablement_quickguide_v1.docx by 2028-05-07)
- CS training (two sessions): Marissa Cole + Priya Natarajan (schedule by 2028-05-08)
- Staging & smoke test slot: Kimberly Park (reserve 4-hr slot week of 2028-05-20)
- Rollback owner & gating thresholds: Kimberly Park (define SLV and automated rollback rules by 2028-05-10)
- Procurement/cost exception: Vivek Kulkarni (coordinate with finance, decision by 2028-05-08)

Acme/Partner liaison: Ill call Jordan and Sara this afternoon to confirm the tradeoffs and the staged ramp plan. Ill share the short one-pager (acme_compressed_timeline_proposal.pdf) with the decision and the gap matrix.

Attachments: enablement_quickguide_v1.docx, gap_risk_matrix.xlsx
Links: https://notion.redwood.com/launchsprint/Acme-compression-plan (operational plan), JIRA-REQ-7821 (procurement request)

If anyone thinks this is missing a critical blocker, flag it now — otherwise Ill proceed to notify Acme and kick the procurement path.

Thanks everyone —
Alex Martinez
Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
